title: Comparison with the Stacks Project adic constructible category
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and let
$\operatorname{Res}\colon D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_{E,X})\to D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},(\cO_E)_X)$ be restriction
of scalars along the map from the constant sheaf. Let $\Dc(X,\cO_E)$ be the full subcategory of
$D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},(\cO_E)_X)$ of \stacks{09C1}: derived $\pi_E$-complete complexes $L$ such that
$L\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\cO_E}\cO_E/\pi_E$ has finite Tor dimension and constructible cohomology
sheaves (pulled back from $X_{\mathrm{ét}}$). Then for $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_{E,X})$:
$$
K\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)\iff\operatorname{Res}K\in\Dc(X,\cO_E),
$$
and $\operatorname{Res}$ restricts to an equivalence $\Dbc(X,\cO_E)\simeq\Dc(X,\cO_E)$.

proof.text: Put $R=\mathcal O_E$, $B=\mathcal O_{E,X}$, $k=R/\pi_E$ and $L=\operatorname{Res}K$. The completed coefficient identification [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit] and part (3) of [det-prop-integral-criterion-constant-coefficients] identify both first derived reductions with the same object $M=K\otimes_B^L k_X\simeq L\otimes_{R_X}^L k_X$.

source.place: Unit proof (1)–(2), coefficient map and residue identification

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-restriction-local-completeness], applied to $R_X\to B$ and $(\pi_E)$, $K$ is locally derived complete exactly when $L$ is. The DVR statement [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr] makes $R$ Noetherian: every ideal has one generator. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] applies to $R$, $(\pi_E)$ and the completion $B$ of step 1; its unit compatibility identifies local and quotient-tower completeness on both sides. This checks the conventions needed for the complete-object equivalence below.

source.place: Tag 099C, lemma-restriction-derived-complete; completion conventions: proetale.tex Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion

proof.text: Noetherian $X$ is quasi-compact and locally Noetherian; [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated] supplies quasi-separatedness. The residue $k$ is a finite field [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], hence discrete Noetherian (its only ideals are $0,k$). Apply [lem-sfb-constructible-local-tor-etale-origin] to $M$: its constructible cohomology and local finite Tor dimension are equivalent to bounded constructible étale origin with finite Tor amplitude.

source.place: Tag 09C1, definition-Dbc, residue condition; étale origin supplied by the extracted lemma

proof.text: [lem-sfb-integral-cohomological-adic-criterion] says $K\in\Dbc(X,R)$ exactly when $K$ is locally derived complete and its first reduction has the étale origin of step 3. Substitute the reduction identification of step 1, the completeness equivalence of step 2, and the residue criterion of step 3. The étale constructibility conventions agree: over the field $k$, finitely generated means finite-dimensional, and on Noetherian $X$ the affine-local strata of [def-pe-etale-constructible-module] give one global stratification by [lem-sfb-noetherian-global-constructibility] (étale site, $R=k$), the converse being restriction to affine opens. The resulting conjunction is precisely the definition of $L\in\Dc(X,R)$, proving both implications for arbitrary $K$.

source.place: Unit proof (1)–(2), comparison with the integral criterion

proof.text: Part (2) of [det-prop-integral-criterion-constant-coefficients], with the convention check of step 2, gives an equivalence on complete objects. Step 4 identifies the selected full subcategories. Restriction is fully faithful on them since the Hom maps are unchanged. Given $L\in\Dc(X,R)$, its complete preimage $K$ lies in $\Dbc(X,R)$ by step 4. This proves essential surjectivity and the asserted equivalence induced by $\operatorname{Res}$.

source.place: Unit proof (1)–(2), equivalence restricted to the selected objects

lean.statement: theorem integral_models_stacks (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] : (∀ K, constantModelBoundedConstructible (integersObj l E) X K ↔ stacksConstructible l E X ((restriction l E X).obj K)) ∧ ∃ e : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible (integersObj l E) X ≌ (stacksConstructible l E X).FullSubcategory, Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ (stacksConstructible l E X).ι ≅ (constantModelBoundedConstructible (integersObj l E) X).ι ⋙ restriction l E X)
lean.note: The auxiliary definitions spell out the Stacks category introduced in the statement and the specified restriction functor. Completeness uses the existing local predicate after sectionwise transport to an equivalent small site. Coefficients and maps are constructed from actual constant sheaves, constant continuous functions, and the scalar quotient; no comparison or functor is postulated.
